answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 3 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The ledge multiplier is published, charged in onyx, and atlas lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 621 identities would post 4440 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
